en.hero_about_text: Embedded software engineer at Alflex Technologies, where I write firmware in C on FreeRTOS and ESP32 and build the C# tooling around it. Co-founder of Btrkoop, a grocery price-comparison app with 6,500+ users. In my own time I build embedded projects, like a GPS handheld on Zephyr RTOS. My experience and projects are below.
